description: This is a Makefile fragment from the OpenWrt project defining default build configurations, package metadata, and build steps. It contains variable definitions, build rules, and function-like constructs for configuring, compiling, and installing packages within the OpenWrt build system.
external_files: external scripts or Makefiles invoked during build steps

methods.name: Build/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the package by running the configure script with the appropriate environment variables and replacing config scripts if necessary.

methods.name: Build/Compile/Default
methods.description: Compiles the package source code using make with specified variables.

methods.name: Build/Install/Default
methods.description: Installs the compiled package into the staging directory.

methods.name: Build/Dist/Default
methods.description: Creates a distribution archive of the package.

methods.name: Build/DistCheck/Default
methods.description: Performs distcheck to verify the distribution package.
